Rockfall Prediction System: 2025 
RockSense is an AI -driven system currently being developed for rockfall risk assessment and early prediction. The project 
integrates computer vision and machine learning techniques to analyze visual inputs and detect potential hazards. The backend

generation. The system architecture includes data logging, threshold -based risk categorization (Low/Medium/High), and 
structured workflow ma nagement to ensure scalability and efficiency. This project strengthens my skills in backend 
development, AI model integration, and system design for real-world safety applications. 
Community Forum Platform: 2025 
A full-stack web application that allows users to create posts, comment, like, vote, and participate in discussions across multiple 
community topics. The backend is developed using Spring Boot with MVC architecture and database management through 
Spring Data JPA and MySQL/H2. The frontend is built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap for a clean and responsive 
user interface. The project also includes user profile features with dynamic avatar generation and session-based interaction. 
City Explorer: 2025 
Developed a Django-based web application that allows users to search and explore city attractions, including accommodation, 
food facilities, and ratings. Implemented user authentication, backend logic, and database integration to manage dynamic content 
efficiently.
